message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 fail.

The test failed because `src/api/users.js` wrote to a `full_name` column. Migration 001 creates that column as `fullname`. I renamed it to `fullname` in `src/api/users.js`. The returned `fullName` field is unchanged.

I left the migration alone. It is already applied in production and belongs to the DBA team, so changing the code was the safer fix.
